decision: Keep the gfx1151 projection/head/KV composite as the exact production default. The three-run throughput median is 0.110% below the prior checkpoint within shared-APU variance, but the complete trace proves 48 fewer dispatches/token, a 0.039615-ms/token shorter kernel span, and 0.124196-ms/token less span-minus-kernel time. This is retained as a verified cycle-wall and launch-count improvement, not as a headline throughput increase.
